verses.original: הֵ֛ן יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹֽא־ קָצְרָ֥ה מֵֽהוֹשִׁ֑יעַ אָזְנ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ כָבְדָ֥ה מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hên yaḏ- Yah·weh lō- qā·ṣə·rāh mê·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’ā·zə·nōw wə·lō- ḵā·ḇə·ḏāh miš·šə·mō·w·a‘
verses.literal: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save nor His ear . . . too dull to hear

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ עֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ הָי֣וּ מַבְדִּלִ֔ים בֵּינֵכֶ֕ם לְבֵ֖ין אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם וְחַטֹּֽאותֵיכֶ֗ם הִסְתִּ֧ירוּ פָנִ֛ים מִכֶּ֖ם מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·ḵem hā·yū maḇ·di·lîm bê·nê·ḵem lə·ḇên ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯê·ḵem his·tî·rū p̄ā·nîm mik·kem miš·šə·mō·w·a‘
verses.literal: But . . . your iniquities . . . have built barriers between you . . . and your God and your sins have hidden [His] face from you so that He does not hear

verses.original: כִּ֤י כַפֵּיכֶם֙ נְגֹאֲל֣וּ בַדָּ֔ם וְאֶצְבְּעוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֶּֽעָוֺ֑ן שִׂפְתֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ דִּבְּרוּ־ שֶׁ֔קֶר לְשׁוֹנְכֶ֖ם תֶהְגֶּֽה׃ עַוְלָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: kî ḵap·pê·ḵem nə·ḡō·’ă·lū ḇad·dām wə·’eṣ·bə·‘ō·w·ṯê·ḵem be·‘ā·wōn śip̄·ṯō·w·ṯê·ḵem dib·bə·rū- še·qer lə·šō·wn·ḵem ṯeh·geh ‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with iniquity your lips have spoken lies and your tongue mutters injustice

verses.original: אֵין־ קֹרֵ֣א בְצֶ֔דֶק וְאֵ֥ין נִשְׁפָּ֖ט בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה בָּט֤וֹחַ עַל־ תֹּ֙הוּ֙ וְדַבֶּר־ שָׁ֔וְא הָר֥וֹ עָמָ֖ל וְהוֹלֵ֥יד אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- qō·rê ḇə·ṣe·ḏeq wə·’ên niš·pāṭ be·’ĕ·mū·nāh bā·ṭō·w·aḥ ‘al- tō·hū wə·ḏab·ber- šāw hā·rōw ‘ā·māl wə·hō·w·lêḏ ’ā·wen
verses.literal: No one calls for justice no one pleads his case honestly They rely on empty [pleas] they tell lies they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity

verses.original: בִּקֵּ֔עוּ בֵּיצֵ֤י צִפְעוֹנִי֙ יֶאֱרֹ֑גוּ עַכָּבִ֖ישׁ וְקוּרֵ֥י הָאֹכֵ֤ל מִבֵּֽיצֵיהֶם֙ יָמ֔וּת וְהַזּוּרֶ֖ה אֶפְעֶֽה׃ תִּבָּקַ֥ע
verses.transliteration: biq·qê·‘ū bê·ṣê ṣip̄·‘ō·w·nî ye·’ĕ·rō·ḡū ‘ak·kā·ḇîš wə·qū·rê hā·’ō·ḵêl mib·bê·ṣê·hem yā·mūṯ wə·haz·zū·reh ’ep̄·‘eh tib·bā·qa‘
verses.literal: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web Whoever eats their eggs will die crack one open and a viper is hatched

verses.original: קֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לֹא־ יִהְי֣וּ לְבֶ֔גֶד וְלֹ֥א יִתְכַּסּ֖וּ בְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ אָ֔וֶן מַֽעֲשֵׂי־ וּפֹ֥עַל חָמָ֖ס בְּכַפֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qū·rê·hem lō- yih·yū lə·ḇe·ḡeḏ wə·lō yiṯ·kas·sū bə·ma·‘ă·śê·hem ma·‘ă·śê·hem ’ā·wen ma·‘ă·śê- ū·p̄ō·‘al ḥā·mās bə·ḵap·pê·hem
verses.literal: Their cobwebs cannot be made into clothing and they cannot cover themselves with their works Their deeds are sinful deeds and acts of violence are in their hands

verses.original: רַגְלֵיהֶם֙ יָרֻ֔צוּ לָרַ֣ע וִֽימַהֲר֔וּ לִשְׁפֹּ֖ךְ נָקִ֑י דָּ֣ם מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ אָ֔וֶן מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת שֹׁ֥ד וָשֶׁ֖בֶר בִּמְסִלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: raḡ·lê·hem yā·ru·ṣū lā·ra‘ wî·ma·hă·rū liš·pōḵ nā·qî dām maḥ·šə·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem ’ā·wen maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ šōḏ wā·še·ḇer bim·sil·lō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Their feet run to evil they are swift to shed innocent blood Their thoughts are sinful thoughts ruin and destruction lie in their wake

verses.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ שָׁלוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ וְאֵ֥ין מִשְׁפָּ֖ט בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָ֑ם לָהֶ֔ם עִקְּשׁ֣וּ נְתִיבֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ כֹּ֚ל לֹ֥א דֹּרֵ֣ךְ בָּ֔הּ יָדַ֖ע שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ šā·lō·wm lō yā·ḏā·‘ū wə·’ên miš·pāṭ bə·ma‘·gə·lō·w·ṯām lā·hem ‘iq·qə·šū nə·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem kōl lō dō·rêḵ bāh yā·ḏa‘ šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: The way of peace they have not known and there is no justice in their tracks They have turned them into crooked paths no one . . . who treads on them will know peace

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן מִשְׁפָּט֙ רָחַ֤ק מִמֶּ֔נּוּ צְדָקָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א תַשִּׂיגֵ֖נוּ נְקַוֶּ֤ה לָאוֹר֙ וְהִנֵּה־ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לִנְגֹה֖וֹת נְהַלֵּֽךְ׃ בָּאֲפֵל֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên miš·pāṭ rā·ḥaq mim·men·nū ṣə·ḏā·qāh wə·lō ṯaś·śî·ḡê·nū nə·qaw·weh lā·’ō·wr wə·hin·nêh- ḥō·šeḵ lin·ḡō·hō·wṯ nə·hal·lêḵ bā·’ă·p̄ê·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Therefore . . . justice is far from us and righteousness does not reach us We hope for light but there is darkness for brightness [but] we walk in gloom

verses.original: כַֽעִוְרִים֙ נְגַֽשְׁשָׁ֤ה קִ֔יר נְגַשֵּׁ֑שָׁה וּכְאֵ֥ין עֵינַ֖יִם כָּשַׁ֤לְנוּ בַֽצָּהֳרַ֙יִם֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁף בָּאַשְׁמַנִּ֖ים כַּמֵּתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḵa·‘iw·rîm nə·ḡaš·šāh qîr nə·ḡaš·šê·šāh ū·ḵə·’ên ‘ê·na·yim kā·šal·nū ḇaṣ·ṣā·ho·ra·yim kan·ne·šep̄ bā·’aš·man·nîm kam·mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: Like the blind we feel our way along the wall groping like those without eyes We stumble at midday as in the twilight among the vigorous we are like the dead

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֔נוּ נֶהֱמֶ֤ה כַדֻּבִּים֙ הָגֹ֣ה נֶהְגֶּ֑ה וְכַיּוֹנִ֖ים נְקַוֶּ֤ה לַמִּשְׁפָּט֙ וָאַ֔יִן לִֽישׁוּעָ֖ה רָחֲקָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lā·nū ne·hĕ·meh ḵad·dub·bîm hā·ḡōh neh·geh wə·ḵay·yō·w·nîm nə·qaw·weh lam·miš·pāṭ wā·’a·yin lî·šū·‘āh rā·ḥă·qāh mim·men·nū
verses.literal: We all growl like bears and moan . . . like doves We hope for justice but [find] none for salvation but it is far from us

verses.original: כִּֽי־ פְשָׁעֵ֙ינוּ֙ רַבּ֤וּ נֶגְדֶּ֔ךָ וְחַטֹּאותֵ֖ינוּ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֑נוּ פְשָׁעֵ֣ינוּ כִּֽי־ אִתָּ֔נוּ יְדַֽעֲנֽוּם׃ וַעֲוֺנֹתֵ֖ינוּ
verses.transliteration: kî- p̄ə·šā·‘ê·nū rab·bū neḡ·de·ḵā wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯê·nū ‘ā·nə·ṯāh bā·nū p̄ə·šā·‘ê·nū kî- ’it·tā·nū yə·ḏa·‘ă·nūm wa·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: For our transgressions are multiplied before You and our sins testify against us Our transgressions are indeed with us and we know our iniquities

verses.original: פָּשֹׁ֤עַ וְכַחֵשׁ֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וְנָס֖וֹג מֵאַחַ֣ר אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ דַּבֶּר־ עֹ֣שֶׁק וְסָרָ֔ה הֹר֧וֹ וְהֹג֛וֹ שָֽׁקֶר׃ דִּבְרֵי־ מִלֵּ֖ב
verses.transliteration: pā·šō·a‘ wə·ḵa·ḥêš Yah·weh wə·nā·sō·wḡ mê·’a·ḥar ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū dab·ber- ‘ō·šeq wə·sā·rāh hō·rōw wə·hō·ḡōw šā·qer diḇ·rê- mil·lêḇ
verses.literal: rebelling and denying the LORD turning away from our God speaking oppression and revolt conceiving and uttering lies - from the heart

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְהֻסַּ֤ג אָחוֹר֙ וּצְדָקָ֖ה תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מֵרָח֣וֹק כִּֽי־ אֱמֶ֔ת כָשְׁלָ֤ה בָֽרְחוֹב֙ וּנְכֹחָ֖ה לֹא־ תוּכַ֥ל לָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: miš·pāṭ wə·hus·saḡ ’ā·ḥō·wr ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ta·‘ă·mōḏ mê·rā·ḥō·wq kî- ’ĕ·meṯ ḵā·šə·lāh ḇā·rə·ḥō·wḇ ū·nə·ḵō·ḥāh lō- ṯū·ḵal lā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: So justice is turned away . . . and righteousness stands at a distance For truth has stumbled in the public square and honesty cannot . . . enter

verses.original: הָֽאֱמֶת֙ וַתְּהִ֤י נֶעְדֶּ֔רֶת וְסָ֥ר מֵרָ֖ע מִשְׁתּוֹלֵ֑ל יְהוָ֛ה וַיַּ֧רְא וַיֵּ֥רַע בְּעֵינָ֖יו כִּֽי־ אֵ֥ין מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ĕ·meṯ wat·tə·hî ne‘·de·reṯ wə·sār mê·rā‘ miš·tō·w·lêl Yah·weh way·yar way·yê·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nāw kî- ’ên miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Truth is missing and whoever turns from evil becomes prey The LORD looked and was displeased . . . that there was no justice

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ כִּֽי־ אֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וַיִּשְׁתּוֹמֵ֖ם כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין מַפְגִּ֑יעַ זְרֹע֔וֹ וַתּ֤וֹשַֽׁע לוֹ֙ וְצִדְקָת֖וֹ הִ֥יא סְמָכָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar kî- ’ên ’îš way·yiš·tō·w·mêm kî ’ên map̄·gî·a‘ zə·rō·‘ōw wat·tō·wō·ša‘ lōw wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw hî sə·mā·ḵā·ṯə·hū
verses.literal: He saw that there was no man He was amazed that there was no one to intercede So His own arm brought salvation and His own righteousness . . . sustained Him

verses.original: וַיִּלְבַּ֤שׁ צְדָקָה֙ כַּשִּׁרְיָ֔ן וְכ֥וֹבַע יְשׁוּעָ֖ה בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיִּלְבַּ֞שׁ בִּגְדֵ֤י תִּלְבֹּ֔שֶׁת נָקָם֙ וַיַּ֥עַט כַּמְעִ֖יל קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·baš ṣə·ḏā·qāh kaš·šir·yān wə·ḵō·w·ḇa‘ yə·šū·‘āh bə·rō·šōw way·yil·baš biḡ·ḏê til·bō·šeṯ nā·qām way·ya·‘aṭ kam·‘îl qin·’āh
verses.literal: He put on righteousness like a breastplate and the helmet of salvation on His head He put on garments . . . of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal

verses.original: יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם כְּעַ֤ל גְּמֻלוֹת֙ כְּעַ֣ל חֵמָ֣ה לְצָרָ֔יו גְּמ֖וּל לְאֹֽיְבָ֑יו גְּמ֥וּל יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ לָאִיִּ֖ים
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·lêm kə·‘al gə·mu·lō·wṯ kə·‘al ḥê·māh lə·ṣā·rāw gə·mūl lə·’ō·yə·ḇāw gə·mūl yə·šal·lêm lā·’î·yîm
verses.literal: So He will repay according to their deeds - fury to His enemies retribution to His foes and recompense - to the islands

verses.original: וְיִֽירְא֤וּ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה מִֽמַּעֲרָב֙ שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֶת־ כְּבוֹד֑וֹ וּמִמִּזְרַח־ אֶת־ כִּֽי־ יָב֤וֹא צָ֔ר כַנָּהָר֙ נֹ֥סְסָה בֽוֹ׃ ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·yî·rə·’ū šêm Yah·weh mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ še·meš ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw ū·mim·miz·raḥ- ’eṯ- kî- yā·ḇō·w ṣār ḵan·nā·hār nō·sə·sāh ḇōw rū·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets . . . - and His glory where [it] rises - For He will come like a raging flood driven by the breath of the LORD

verses.original: גּוֹאֵ֔ל וּבָ֤א לְצִיּוֹן֙ בְּיַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וּלְשָׁבֵ֥י פֶ֖שַׁע נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gō·w·’êl ū·ḇā lə·ṣî·yō·wn bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·lə·šā·ḇê p̄e·ša‘ nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: The Redeemer will come to Zion to those in Jacob who turn from transgression declares the LORD

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה רוּחִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יךָ וּדְבָרַ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי בְּפִ֑יךָ לֹֽא־ יָמ֡וּשׁוּ מִפִּיךָ֩ וּמִפִּ֨י זַרְעֲךָ֜ וּמִפִּ֨י זֶ֤רַע זַרְעֲךָ֙ מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃ס אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî zōṯ bə·rî·ṯî ’ō·w·ṯām ’ā·mar Yah·weh rū·ḥî ’ă·šer ‘ā·le·ḵā ū·ḏə·ḇā·ray ’ă·šer- śam·tî bə·p̄î·ḵā lō- yā·mū·šū mip·pî·ḵā ū·mip·pî zar·‘ă·ḵā ū·mip·pî ze·ra‘ zar·‘ă·ḵā mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: As for Me this is My covenant with them says the LORD My Spirit [will not depart] from you and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children [and] vvv grandchildren from now on and forevermore says the LORD
